records.synonym_note: POWO/WCVP accepts Persicaria glabra (Willd.) M.Gómez; Polygonum glabrum Willd. and Amblygonum glabrum are homotypic synonyms. Some historical Polygonum names are illegitimate later homonyms. Keep Polygonum glabrum as a searchable alias, not a duplicate accepted learner species. Accepted name does not validate the source observation or photo.
